description:
THE ACCOUNT-BREAK MECHANICS of app/cbl/CBACT04C.cbl:193-206 - WHEN 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT runs and WHICH account it targets. case11.json pins WHAT 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT writes, field by field; this case pins the sequencing around it, which no other case in this folder isolates. Three TCATBALF rows, three different accounts, one row each, produce THREE REWRITE DECISIONS and only TWO REWRITES.

FACT 1 - THE REWRITE TARGETS THE PREVIOUS ACCOUNT. PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT at :196 executes BEFORE :202 moves TRANCAT-ACCT-ID into FD-ACCT-ID and BEFORE :203 performs 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA, so at the moment the REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM ACCOUNT-RECORD at :356 fires, ACCOUNT-RECORD still holds the account read on the PREVIOUS break. Row 2's break therefore rewrites account 00000000001 and row 3's break rewrites account 00000000002.

FACT 2 - MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT AT :200 RUNS AFTER THE REWRITE AT :196. Each account's accumulated interest is applied before it is discarded, and is never contaminated by its successor's. Row 2's break applies WS-TOTAL-INT = 2.42, which is account 1's own interest and nothing else.

FACT 3 - WS-FIRST-TIME SUPPRESSES THE REWRITE ON THE FIRST BREAK. WS-FIRST-TIME PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y' (:170) makes the IF at :195 false on row 1, so :198 flips it to 'N' and no rewrite occurs at that moment - correctly, because no account has been read yet.

FACT 4 - THE LAST ACCOUNT GROUP IS NEVER REWRITTEN. The only other call site for 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT is the ELSE at :219-220, and it is UNREACHABLE DEAD CODE: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' at :188 means the IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' at :189 is always true when the body runs. Account 00000000003 accumulates 1.83 and that 1.83 is never applied, so its ACCT-CURR-BAL stays at the fixture's 00000001470{ = 147.00. That is preserved behaviour, not a defect to repair (practice B5): implementing the dead ELSE would post 148.83 = 00000001488C, which this case asserts must NOT appear.

WHY THE THREE INTEREST VALUES ARE DELIBERATELY ALL DIFFERENT. 2.42, 1.97 and 1.83 are distinct, so a total attributed to the wrong account is visible rather than masked by coincidence. Every plausible failure has its own signature, and each is named here so the case is diagnostic and not merely correct:
  - CORRECT: account 1 -> 194.00 + 2.42 = 196.42 = 00000001964B; account 2 -> 158.00 + 1.97 = 159.97 = 00000001599G; account 3 -> unchanged 00000001470{.
  - If the rewrite targeted the CURRENT account (:196 moved after :203), account 1 would stay 00000001940{, account 2 would show 160.42 = 00000001604B and account 3 would show 148.97 = 00000001489G.
  - If :200 were moved BEFORE the rewrite, both rewrites would apply zero and both accounts would stay at 00000001940{ and 00000001580{.
  - If WS-TOTAL-INT were never reset, account 2 would show 158.00 + 2.42 + 1.97 = 162.39 = 00000001623I.
  - If WS-FIRST-TIME did not suppress the first break, the run would rewrite an account never read, raising ERROR RE-WRITING ACCOUNT FILE (:365) and a non-zero RETURN-CODE; this case expects exactly eleven messages, none of them that line, and RETURN-CODE 0.

ARITHMETIC AND ROUNDING (gates G23, G24, G25). COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200 at :464-465 carries NO ROUNDED phrase - the keyword appears zero times in all 28 programs - and its receiver is WS-MONTHLY-INT PIC S9(09)V99 (:168), so the store TRUNCATES: BigDecimal at SCALE 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN. All three quotients are half-boundary discriminators: 194.00x15.00/1200 = 2.4250 -> 2.42, 158.00x15.00/1200 = 1.9750 -> 1.97, 147.00x15.00/1200 = 1.8375 -> 1.83. HALF_UP would give 2.43, 1.98 and 1.84, encoded 0000000024C, 0000000019H and 0000000018D, none of which may appear. ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT TO WS-TOTAL-INT (:467) runs three times and ADD WS-TOTAL-INT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL (:352) runs twice (gate G28).

THE RATE, AND THE 16-BYTE DISCLOSURE KEY. All 50 rows of acctdata.txt carry ACCT-GROUP-ID as TEN SPACES at bytes 113-122, with A000000000 sitting in ACCT-ADDR-ZIP at bytes 103-112 instead. The folder brief's claim that these accounts carry a group id is WRONG and the correction is recorded here rather than applied silently (practice B4). Spaces therefore reach FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID at :210, the READ at :416 reports '23', and every one of the three records takes the MOVE 'DEFAULT' retry at :437-438. DEFAULT   /01/0001 is discgrp.txt row 17, whose DIS-INT-RATE reads 00150{ = 15.00 at BYTES 17-22, because CVTRA02Y's DIS-GROUP-KEY is SIXTEEN bytes (X(10) + X(02) + 9(04)); a 17-byte assumption would read bytes 18-23 and corrupt the rate (practice B11).

THE THREE GENERATED TRANSACTIONS. WS-TRANID-SUFFIX PIC 9(06) VALUE 0 is incremented at :474 BEFORE the STRING at :476-480, and is never reset, so the identifiers are 2022071800000001, 2022071800000002 and 2022071800000003 - contiguous from 000001, never 000000, and counting across account boundaries rather than restarting per account. TRAN-CAT-CD is 0005 because MOVE '05' (:483) targets a numeric-display PIC 9(04) receiver, so it is four bytes and never '05  '. TRAN-DESC X(100) is the 24-byte prefix - 'Int. for a/c ' is 13 characters including its trailing space, plus the 11-digit ACCT-ID - followed by 76 spaces, because STRING does not blank the receiver tail and common.FixedWidthCodec space-initialises the area; the ACCT-ID comes from the account read at :203 and so changes on every row. TRAN-CARD-NUM comes from XREF-CARD-NUM (:495): cardxref.txt is ordered by CARD NUMBER, not by account, so the rows are found by matching bytes 26-36 - account 1 at zero-based row 48, account 2 at row 2, account 3 at row 16.

1400-COMPUTE-FEES CONTRIBUTES NOTHING. It is performed three times at :216, inside the satisfied IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0 guard at :214, and its body is the comment '* To be implemented' followed by EXIT. at :518-520 - zero statements. It produces no record, no field, no message and no change to any balance (gate G26, practice B5).

CHANNELS, WIDTHS AND ORDER. The generated transactions are the only WRITES channel output, three rows at zero-based write positions 0, 1 and 2, each 350 bytes as app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:39 declares RECFM=F,LRECL=350 (gates G19, G20). The two account rewrites are asserted on the FINAL_STATE channel, where rowIndex is the row's position in the dataset and account k sits at index k-1; each is 300 bytes with FILLER X(178) emitted as 178 spaces and ACCT-GROUP-ID as ten spaces (gate G21). The gate G27 order inside 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT is ADD WS-TOTAL-INT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL (:352), then MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT (:353), then MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT (:354), and only then REWRITE (:356). Every other seeded dataset is pinned unchanged, row for row, so 'the inputs were not disturbed' is an assertion: all 50 cross-reference rows on BOTH access paths, all 51 disclosure rows and all three category-balance rows. The misspelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE is spelled as app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy spells it.

INPUTS AND THEIR PROVENANCE (practice B12). The three TCATBALF rows are MODIFIED: every one of the 50 real balances in tcatbal.txt is 0000000000{ = 0.00, and interest on zero is zero at any rate, so the fixture cannot drive this case. Each row is the fixture's own row for that account - key 00000000000k/01/0001 with the same 22-byte zero-filled trailing span - with ONLY TRAN-CAT-BAL replaced, and the three replacements 194.00, 158.00 and 147.00 are the REAL ACCT-CURR-BAL values of accounts 1, 2 and 3 in acctdata.txt (00000001940{, 00000001580{, 00000001470{), so the amounts are fixture-derived rather than invented. ACCTFILE is the UNMODIFIED acctdata.txt, all 50 rows: this case asserts balance DELTAS, and the cycle-amount zeroing is already owned by case11.json, so no account override is needed - accounts 1 and 2 already carry 00000000000{ in both cycle fields, which the rewrite leaves at zero. XREFFILE and XREFFIL1 are the SAME cardxref.txt seeded twice, because app/jcl/INTCALC.jcl:29 and :31 open the base KSDS and the alternate-index PATH OVER THAT SAME CLUSTER in one step - two access paths, one cluster, neither mutated (gate G45). Its rows measure 36 bytes where CVACT03Y declares 50, so both carry CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 and the absent FILLER X(14) is supplied as fourteen spaces once, at seed time, by the harness rather than pre-padded in this file (gate G16). DISCGRP is the unmodified discgrp.txt, all 51 rows. SYSTRAN is output only and is not seeded. Every dataset is addressed by its binding key and no dataset name appears anywhere in this file (gate G46); the charset is US-ASCII, never a platform default (practice B8).

DETERMINISM (practice B7). Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP at :613-626 builds DB2-FORMAT-TS X(26) from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE and :497-498 move the same value into TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS - the only wall-clock values the program produces. Both are pinned on all three records to the harness's fixed clock, ParityHarness.DEFAULT_PINNED_CLOCK of 2022-07-19T23:12:34, rendered YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.mm0000 as 2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000 with the hundredths field zero - never a captured 'now'. The two account rewrites carry no timestamp at all and are deterministic on their own.

INVOCATION AND BASELINE. unitKind BATCH_JOB: account.AccountInterestCalcJob is reached at step level through calculateInterest, with no JobLauncher, no job repository and no HTTP layer in the path (gate G51). review_rules reports NO USER RULES PROVIDED for this project; their absence is not permission to lower the bar, so the plan's enterprise practices bind instead. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of the COBOL, the copybook byte layouts, the JCL DD and PARM contracts and the real ASCII fixtures - and NEVER captured from an execution of the legacy COBOL, which is empirically impossible in this environment (risk R-A).
